alt: 家人安靜陪伴高齡祖父在家中安詳離世，屋內灑著溫暖晨光。
scene_prompt: 壽終正寢 in its traditional sense is an elderly man who has lived a full life and dies naturally at home. Show an elderly grandfather peacefully resting in his own bed after a long life, eyes closed and serene beneath a light blanket, with family nearby holding hands and quietly remembering him. Warm morning light, a few well-loved books and a framed blank landscape picture establish a lived-in home. Tender, calm and non-graphic: no medical crisis, visible distress, funeral symbols or medical equipment. Family is sad but comforted. All people natural with exactly two arms and legs; hands gently held, body supported by bed and pillow, contact plausible.
style_prompt: Create ONE gentle, respectful children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom. Delicate graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor and colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, muted natural colors. No words, logos or watermarks.
